_note: Established terrestrial analog sites used by NASA, ESA and partner field campaigns. Used only to test the method: a good similarity score should rank them high without being told about them. set = "core" for the original 19 sites, "extended" for the 12 added later; the method check reports both. Coordinates are rounded to ~0.1°.
